messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: removing C++11 features from tests
parts:
Daniel and I put our heads together and we'll
remove the C++11 features (function template parameter
defaults) and replace them with plain old C++
(which means pushing the functions into static class
functions and putting the defaults on the class).

With that, I think we should be OK to do the
1.0.4 release without C++11 support.

In the meantime, I'll try to track down errors
we're having with C++11 compatibility. It looks
like Ben's bringing all sorts of interesting tools
to the debugging table.

- Bob
